title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Cola Lime Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Cola Lime Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a lively blend of classic drink flavours with a citrus twist. The deep caramel and subtle spice of Cola provides a familiar rich, sweet base, while sharp Lime brings a tangy brightness that lifts the profile. Together, they create a refreshing, slightly fizzy vape inspired by a zesty twist on a soft drink favourite. Each pod is filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods fit securely via magnetic connection and are compatible with the dual-flavour twist activation system. With two pods in each pack, Cola Lime makes a distinctive pairing option or an excellent choice for fans of drink-inspired flavours.
